silicon_melting_3.name: Melting of Silicon - Level 3
silicon_melting_3.description: Simulate the melting of Silicon by heating under NPT conditions using the Stillinger–Weber (SW) potential and the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the system by 3 times in each direction. Compute the diffusion constant (self-diffusivity) in the molten state and report the average value in m²/s.
